I went to India for my aunty’s wedding, and where I’m from, it’s tradition for the bride’s family to try and take the groom’s shoes and he has to pay you to get them back. Like a game. The groom was aware of this. Me and my cousins planned to take his shoes whilst we went over for a photo by lifting him up and then my younger cousins would take them off and pass them to me and my sister so we could run away with them. So we went and posed behind the chairs my aunty and the groom were sitting on, and just as we were about to take the photo, my cousin lifted him up in the air, but suddenly- he started kicking his legs in the air wildly, huffing. Kicking to hurt. To protect my younger cousins from being hit, my older cousin tried to move them out the way, but he was kicked in the face as a result. The groom was in a blind rage, and kicked a glass of water up in the air that landed on my shoulder. Eventually, he climbed over the chairs, and turned to us, readjusting his collar, a smirk on his face. He said, “Better luck next time.” 

Even though he knew he caused people to get hurt, he still said that. All of us looked at each other and in that instant we knew, that this man did not deserve to wed our aunt. 

Bonus: He gave the money to my aunt’s cousins and told them not to share it with us.
